title: Improved Grid-Based Simulation of Coulombic Dynamics
summary: Accurate time-dependent quantum dynamics of Coulombic systems on grid-based representations remains computationally demanding due to the singularity of the Coulomb potential, which necessitates extremely fine spatial grids to mitigate discretisation errors. We propose two complementary correction schemes that, under identical resource budgets, consistently outperform the uncorrected counterparts.
